name: Starbucks Rewards Growth
description: Offer engagement, purchase retention, customer value and campaign evidence from the simulated Rewards observation period.

cards.name: Customers in the dataset
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM loyalty.customers

cards.name: Recorded purchase amount
sql: SELECT SUM(transaction_amount) AS purchase_amount FROM loyalty.transactions

cards.name: Eligible offer deliveries
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_deliveries FROM loyalty.offer_deliveries WHERE eligible_for_rates

cards.name: Following-week purchase retention
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(active_customers)/SUM(cohort_customers),2) AS retention_pct
FROM loyalty.weekly_purchase_retention WHERE weeks_since_first_purchase=1

cards.name: Purchases over the observation period
sql: SELECT time_hours/24 AS observation_day,SUM(transaction_amount) AS purchase_amount
FROM loyalty.transactions GROUP BY observation_day ORDER BY observation_day

cards.name: Reward-bearing delivery funnel
sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT * FROM loyalty.offer_deliveries WHERE eligible_for_rates AND offer_type<>'informational'
[[AND offer_type={{offer_type}}]]), stages AS (
SELECT 1 AS position,'Eligible deliveries' AS stage,COUNT(*) AS deliveries FROM eligible
UNION ALL SELECT 2,'Viewed',COUNT(*) FROM eligible WHERE was_viewed
UNION ALL SELECT 3,'Completed after view',COUNT(*) FROM eligible WHERE completion_status='view_before_completion')
SELECT stage,deliveries FROM stages ORDER BY position

cards.name: First completion and recorded views
sql: SELECT INITCAP(REPLACE(completion_status,'_',' ')) AS "Completion timing",COUNT(*) AS "Deliveries"
FROM loyalty.offer_deliveries WHERE eligible_for_rates AND offer_type<>'informational'
[[AND offer_type={{offer_type}}]]
GROUP BY completion_status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

cards.name: Delivery coverage and exclusions
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT full_window_observed THEN 'Incomplete follow-up'
WHEN NOT eligible_for_rates THEN 'Ambiguous matching with full follow-up' ELSE 'Eligible for rates' END AS "Coverage",COUNT(*) AS "Deliveries"
FROM loyalty.offer_deliveries GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

cards.name: View and completion rates by offer type
sql: SELECT offer_type AS "Offer type",ROUND(100.0*SUM(viewed_deliveries)/NULLIF(SUM(eligible_deliveries),0),2) AS "Viewed (%)",
ROUND(100.0*SUM(completed_after_view)/NULLIF(SUM(eligible_reward_deliveries),0),2) AS "Completed after view (%)"
FROM loyalty.offer_funnel_by_offer [[WHERE offer_type={{offer_type}}]] GROUP BY offer_type ORDER BY offer_type

cards.name: Offer channel combinations
sql: SELECT offer_type AS "Offer type",channel_combination AS "Channels",SUM(eligible_deliveries) AS "Eligible deliveries",
ROUND(100.0*SUM(viewed_deliveries)/NULLIF(SUM(eligible_deliveries),0),2) AS "Viewed (%)",
ROUND(100.0*SUM(completed_after_view)/NULLIF(SUM(eligible_reward_deliveries),0),2) AS "After view (%)"
FROM loyalty.offer_funnel_by_offer [[WHERE offer_type={{offer_type}}]] GROUP BY offer_type,channel_combination ORDER BY offer_type,channel_combination

cards.name: Offer terms and delivery outcomes
sql: SELECT LEFT(offer_id,8) AS "Offer",offer_type AS "Type",difficulty AS "Spend ($)",reward AS "Reward ($)",duration_days AS "Days",
channel_combination AS "Channels",eligible_deliveries AS "Eligible deliveries",view_rate_pct AS "Viewed (%)",
any_completion_rate_pct AS "Completed (%)",completion_after_view_rate_pct AS "After view (%)" FROM loyalty.offer_funnel_by_offer
[[WHERE offer_type={{offer_type}}]] ORDER BY offer_type,difficulty,duration_days

cards.name: Offer-event matching audit
sql: SELECT m.event_type AS "Event",m.match_status AS "Matching status",COUNT(*) AS "Events",
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE m.expiry_boundary_count>0) AS "At expiry"
FROM loyalty.offer_event_matches AS m JOIN loyalty.offers AS o USING(offer_id)
[[WHERE o.offer_type={{offer_type}}]] GROUP BY m.event_type,m.match_status ORDER BY m.event_type,m.match_status

cards.name: Customer value at the end of observation
sql: SELECT rfm_segment AS "Segment",customers AS "Customers",purchases AS "Purchases",total_spend AS "Purchase amount ($)",
spend_share_pct AS "Amount share (%)",spend_per_customer AS "Amount / customer ($)",avg_recency_days AS "Days since purchase"
FROM loyalty.rfm_segment_summary ORDER BY total_spend DESC

cards.name: Purchase retention by first observed purchase week
sql: SELECT c.cohort_week AS "First purchase week",COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS "Customers",
MAX(r.retention_rate_pct) FILTER(WHERE r.weeks_since_first_purchase=0) AS "Week 0 (%)",
MAX(r.retention_rate_pct) FILTER(WHERE r.weeks_since_first_purchase=1) AS "Week 1 (%)",
MAX(r.retention_rate_pct) FILTER(WHERE r.weeks_since_first_purchase=2) AS "Week 2 (%)",
MAX(r.retention_rate_pct) FILTER(WHERE r.weeks_since_first_purchase=3) AS "Week 3 (%)"
FROM loyalty.customer_purchase_cohorts AS c LEFT JOIN loyalty.weekly_purchase_retention AS r USING(cohort_week)
GROUP BY c.cohort_week ORDER BY c.cohort_week

cards.name: Purchasing customers by first observed week
sql: SELECT cohort_week,COUNT(*) AS customers FROM loyalty.customer_purchase_cohorts GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week

cards.name: Offer response by customer segment before receipt
sql: SELECT rfm_segment AS "Pre-offer segment",offer_type AS "Offer type",SUM(eligible_deliveries) AS "Eligible deliveries",
ROUND(100.0*SUM(viewed_deliveries)/NULLIF(SUM(eligible_deliveries),0),2) AS "Viewed (%)",
ROUND(100.0*SUM(completed_after_view)/NULLIF(SUM(eligible_reward_deliveries),0),2) AS "After view (%)"
FROM loyalty.offer_funnel_by_rfm WHERE rfm_segment<>'Insufficient history'
[[AND offer_type={{offer_type}}]] [[AND rfm_segment={{rfm_segment}}]]
GROUP BY rfm_segment,offer_type ORDER BY rfm_segment,offer_type

cards.name: Overall package comparisons with customer-clustered uncertainty
sql: SELECT r.pair_number AS "Pair",INITCAP(a.offer_type)||' $'||a.difficulty||' / $'||a.reward AS "Spend / reward",
a.duration_days||' / '||b.duration_days AS "Days A / B",r.deliveries_a AS "Deliveries A",ROUND(r.rate_a_pct::NUMERIC,2) AS "Rate A (%)",
r.deliveries_b AS "Deliveries B",ROUND(r.rate_b_pct::NUMERIC,2) AS "Rate B (%)",ROUND(r.difference_pp::NUMERIC,2) AS "B - A (pp)",
ROUND(r.ci95_low_pp::NUMERIC,2)||' to '||ROUND(r.ci95_high_pp::NUMERIC,2) AS "95% CI (pp)",
CASE WHEN r.p_holm<0.0001 THEN '<0.0001' ELSE TO_CHAR(r.p_holm,'FM0.0000') END AS "Holm p"
FROM loyalty.campaign_comparison_results AS r JOIN loyalty.offers AS a ON a.offer_id=r.offer_a JOIN loyalty.offers AS b ON b.offer_id=r.offer_b
WHERE r.comparison_scope='overall' [[AND a.offer_type={{offer_type}}]] ORDER BY r.pair_number

cards.name: Exploratory segment comparisons
sql: SELECT r.pair_number AS "Pair",r.rfm_segment AS "Pre-offer segment",r.deliveries_a AS "Deliveries A",ROUND(r.rate_a_pct::NUMERIC,2) AS "Rate A (%)",
r.deliveries_b AS "Deliveries B",ROUND(r.rate_b_pct::NUMERIC,2) AS "Rate B (%)",ROUND(r.difference_pp::NUMERIC,2) AS "B - A (pp)",
ROUND(r.ci95_low_pp::NUMERIC,2)||' to '||ROUND(r.ci95_high_pp::NUMERIC,2) AS "95% CI (pp)",
CASE WHEN r.p_holm<0.0001 THEN '<0.0001' ELSE TO_CHAR(r.p_holm,'FM0.0000') END AS "Holm p"
FROM loyalty.campaign_comparison_results AS r JOIN loyalty.offers AS a ON a.offer_id=r.offer_a
WHERE r.comparison_scope='exploratory' [[AND a.offer_type={{offer_type}}]] [[AND r.rfm_segment={{rfm_segment}}]]
ORDER BY r.pair_number,r.rfm_segment

notes.Overview: Dataset totals cover the simulated observation, hours 0-714. Offer type filters offer charts. Pre-offer segment filters response and exploratory comparisons. The funnel uses eligible reward-bearing deliveries. Same-hour ordering is unknown. The final observation day is partial.
notes.Offers: Rates use fully observed, unambiguous deliveries. Expiry is inclusive. Informational offers use view rates. Channel combinations describe distribution at the offer level.
notes.Customers and retention: Snapshot RFM uses all recorded purchases. Recent means within 72 hours. Quartile cutoffs are 11 purchases and $150.94. Response segments use seven days strictly before receipt. Retention weeks start at hour zero. Blank cells have incomplete observation.
notes.Campaign comparisons: Differences are B minus A in percentage points. A has the shorter duration. Duration and channels change together. Each pair uses shared receipt waves and seven days of prior history. Customer-clustered 95% intervals are individual intervals. Holm p-values adjust three overall and 21 exploratory tests separately.
